chung.Syllabus Name: Programming Fundamentals with Python_Cơ sở lập trình (với Python)
chung.Time Allocation: 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h TE + 1.5h PE + 102.5h self-study
chung.Description:
- Knowledge about programming language has become an essential part of an education in computer science because the realization of ideas, approaches, models, and algorithms is extremely important for the field of education and research as well as production. In order to deploy from an idea to a product, programming language tools are required.
- In recent years, python has emerged as a popular, powerful, multitasking and widely applicable 3rd generation language, especially in some new technology fields such as AI, Fintech, Data Science, IoT, and so on.
- This course covers the essential aspects of programming, including fundamental concepts, coding design, and the Python programming language, with an emphasis on object-oriented programming (OOP), given its importance for advanced software development and subsequent courses.
chung.StudentTasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.
- Student is responsible to do all exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time
- Constantly follow https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information regarding assignment submission and feedback on assignments and project work.

buoi: Chapter 1. Why should you learn to write programs? (Part 1) — 1.1 Creativity and Motivation; 1.2 Computer hardware architecture; 1.3 Understanding programming
1.4 Words and sentences; 1.5 Conversing with Python; 1.6 Terminology: Interpreter and compiler

Chapter 1 (Part 2) — 1.7 Writing a program; 1.8 What is a program?; 1.9 The building blocks of programs; 1.10 What could possibly go wrong?; 1.11 Debugging; 1.12 The learning journey; 1.13 Introduce IDE

Chapter 2 (Part 2) — 2.7 Order of operations; 2.8 Modulus operator; 2.9 String operations
2.10 Asking the user for input; 2.11 Comments; 2.12 Choosing mnemonic variable names; 2.13 Debugging
Chapter 3. Conditional execution — 3.1 Boolean expressions; 3.2 Logical operators; 3.3 Conditional execution; 3.4 Alternative execution
3.5 Chained conditionals; 3.6 Nested conditionals; 3.7 Catching exceptions using try and except; 3.8 Short-circuit evaluation of logical expressions; 3.9 Debugging

8.4 List operations; 8.5 List slices; 8.6 List methods
Chapter 8. Lists (Part 2) — 8.7 Deleting elements; 8.8 Lists and functions; 8.9 Lists and strings; 8.10 Parsing lines
8.11 Objects and values; 8.12 Aliasing; 8.13 List arguments; 8.14 Debugging
Chapter 9. Dictionaries — 9.1 Dictionary as a set of counters; 9.2 Dictionaries and files; 9.3 Looping and dictionaries
Chapter 14. Object-oriented programming — 14.1 Introduction to OOP
14.7 Using Objects and Work with OOP Programs
14.9 Advanced OOP Concepts and Design Patterns
ghiChuKiemChung: Giáo trình chính 'Python for Everybody' (Charles R. Severance) MIỄN PHÍ, đọc online tại py4e.com và tải PDF được — nói rõ cho sinh viên.

Syllabus nhảy từ 'Chapter 10. Tuples' sang 'Chapter 14. Object-oriented programming' — KHÔNG có chương 11, 12, 13. Sách PY4E gốc chỉ có 14 chương và các chương 11-13 (Regex, Networked programs, Databases) không nằm trong môn này. Nêu rõ cho sinh viên, KHÔNG tự thêm.
Buổi 25 trong bản gốc FLM gõ '7/3 Text files and lines' (dấu / thay vì dấu chấm) — ở đây ghi lại là 7.3.
Cột LO dùng nhãn LO1-LO7 trong khi bảng chuẩn đầu ra ghi CLO1-CLO7 — cùng một thứ, trường dùng lẫn lộn.
Pre-Requisite để TRỐNG trên FLM (không ghi 'None') — nói là trường không công bố, đừng suy diễn.
